items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: Arthur Murray can dance them shatters.

ctx.x: For the quartile? Yeah. Certain times, depending what, you know, certain things. But the walls, when you had to walk, you know, it wasn't. Not all of them was fast. And they had, they had, they played a mazooka. They had a waltz, and they had shatters. They all don't play that. They all don't have no shatters. You know how the shatters was. They make so many steps, and the ladies put this out a little bit, and the man waltz around. The shatters was beautiful. They have it, what you call them? Murray, Murray has…
Oh yeah, she still does that. Every year. Oh yeah, she still does that.
